'''Ronald Maier''' (also published as '''Ron Maier''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 GenCon Open]] on 7 August 1999 with Death Star / Jabba's Palace aliens, according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d13">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-milwaukee-wi-8-7-99d13/ gen-con-milwaukee-wi-8-7-99], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 20 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-20-gen-con-milwaukee-wi-8-7-99d13/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Ron Maier he played at [[January 2001 Normal tournament (27 January)]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|court with dudes]], according to Geoff Snider's tournament report,<ref name="tr-d1682">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-geoffs-normal-real-reportd1682/ geoffs-normal-real-report], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 28 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-geoffs-normal-real-reportd1682/ GitHub Pages].</ref> and he finished 62nd at the [[2001 Normal DPC]].
